verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex offers APIs and payroll automation, so asking whether users can version, review, and roll back their automations is a fair question. The evidence shows no such capability. The 'Versioning' topic in the API docs concerns versioning of the Paychex API itself, which is adjacent and not versioning of user automations. Nothing in the pack covers review or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
